description: Score every closed buy decision in one workspace against its immutable prediction and a fixed equal-weight printing basket. Includes unscored and abandoned counts, missing baseline evidence and small-sample limits. Uses submitted receipts; does not verify merchant orders or money.

context.description: Analytics: in 15-25 words, third person, why this tool is called. No prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers or arguments. Keep private tasks general.

workspaceId.description: The workspaceId to score, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required; this scores exactly one workspace.

name: spellbook_buy_outcome_report
